camel_example: aliyun alidns BindInstanceDomains --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId s00000000 --Lang en --DomainNames 'example.com,example.net'
description_en: Binds paid domain names in Alibaba Cloud DNS to an instance ID
description_zh: 绑定付费版DNS域名到实例ID
kebab_example: aliyun alidns bind-instance-domains --lang en --instance-id s00000000 --domain-names example.com,example.net --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindInstanceDomains

- en: English
